zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Fort Lee Borough Center, Residential & Parkway Districts
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 2.48%, with an equalization ratio of 74.2%.
Public education represents 54.8% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 34.2%.
Average residential assessment is $430,360, producing an average annual tax bill of $10,672.93.

equityAnalysis.summary: Fort Lee Borough maintains a consistent residential tax base across its residential zones.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Fort Lee Borough, homeowners pay an average of $10,672.93 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 10.0% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 74.2%, assessed values average ~74.2% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 54.8% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 34.2%, and Bergen County claims 11.0%.
